body.p: Claims 1-20 were originally filed in the present application. In a prior response to a Restriction Requirement, claims 10-20 were canceled, without prejudice or disclaimer. Also, new claims 21-29 were added comprising method/process claims including many of the limitations of original apparatus claims 1-9. In the present response to a second Restriction Requirement, previously added claims 21-29 are withdrawn. No claims are amended and no further claims have been canceled or added, and no new matter has been added by the present amendments. Accordingly, claims 1-9 remain pending and under examination in the present application, and Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the present application in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks. II. RESTRICTION REQUIREMENT
The Office Action has issued a Restriction Requirement of original claims 1-9 and previously added claims 21-29 as allegedly reciting two distinct inventions, as follows:

All of Applicant's arguments and amendments are without prejudice or disclaimer. Additionally, Applicant has merely discussed example distinctions from the cited references. Other distinctions may exist, and Applicant reserves the right to discuss these additional distinctions in a later Response or on Appeal, if appropriate. By not responding to any additional statements made by the Examiner, Applicant does not acquiesce to an such additional statements, such as, for example, any statements relating to what would be obvious to a person of ordinary skill in the art. Moreover, in the course of the foregoing discussions, applicant may have at times referred to claim limitations in shorthand fashion, or may have focused on a particular claim element. These discussions should not be interpreted to mean that the other limitations can be ignored or dismissed. The claims must be viewed as a whole, and each limitation of the claims must be considered when determining the patentability of the claims.

Applicant respectfully submits that the application is now in condition for allowance, and earnestly solicits timely notice of the same. Should the Examiner have any questions, comments or suggestions in furtherance of the prosecution of this application, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney by telephone, facsimile, or electronic mail.

Applicant notes that the two-month deadline for filing a response to the Office Action expires December 31, 2024. Thus, this response is timely and no Extension of Time is believed to be due with the present filing. If it is determined that an Extension of Time is required, such extension is hereby requested. Although no fees are believed to be due with the present response, if any fees are found to be due, the Commissioner is authorized to charge any such fees, or credit any overpayment, to Carstens, Allen & Gourley, LLP, Deposit Account No. 50- 0392, referencing the Attorney Docket number specified herein.
